name: Babyface Ehrlichdoch
personality: Wants to do the right thing before anyone explains which side is selling it.
visual_intent: Good Guy Babyface wrestling archetype,NOT actual baby: round top-heavy ink blob,small cream cap with plain sun badge,tiny teal collar,ONE soft gold medal and little folded handkerchief. Huge earnest unequal eyes,closed nervous toothless crooked smile,well-meaning confusion
biography: Wants to do the right thing before anyone explains which side is selling it. His medal promises that HyperNorm goodness can be identified before the act. A dissonant card asks for help without first choosing a side. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Die gute Absicht wartet auf ihre richtige Zuordnung.

name: Heel Ganzbestimmt
personality: Enjoys being the problem until the audience asks him to stay in character.
visual_intent: Heel Villain: broad square low ink splat,small plum wrestling-show cap,tiny burgundy shoulder cape,ONE miniature championship belt held at flank with blank oval plate. Fierce delighted asymmetrical open bellow with THREE upper teeth,one brow high,no human muscles
biography: Enjoys being the problem until the audience asks him to stay in character. His HyperNorm belt rewards being the necessary villain. A dissonant card asks whether he is allowed to be kind when the audience expects the opposite. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Rolle sieht eine freundliche Abweichung nicht vor.

name: Schiedsrichter Grauzone
personality: Can see both sides clearly enough to delay the decision indefinitely.
visual_intent: Moral Grey Referee: tall crooked pear blob,small grey cap,two TINY black-and-cream striped shirt panels only,ONE whistle and little grey square flag held down. Unequal heavy skeptical lids,huge closed toothless pout
biography: Can see both sides clearly enough to delay the decision indefinitely. His grey HyperNorm flag postpones decisions under the name of balance. A dissonant card asks who must keep waiting while he considers both sides. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Ausgewogenheit verlängert vorläufig die Zuständigkeit.

name: Weichenstellerin Dennoch
personality: Has been handed two options and would like to ask who built the track.
visual_intent: Trolley Problem Switcher: broad lopsided round ink blob,little rust railway cap,two subtle lashes,ONE miniature brass track-switch lever on HANDHELD small base with TWO clearly separated branch marks,no trains/tracks/people scene. Huge anxious unequal eyes,small toothless triangular open mouth
biography: Has been handed two options and would like to ask who built the track. Her HyperNorm lever permits two approved answers and no questions about the track. A dissonant card asks who restricted the choice before she arrived. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Wahlmöglichkeit wurde bereits vor ihrer Übergabe begrenzt.

name: Engelteufel Sowohlals
personality: Finds the moral conflict easier when both voices are using his mouth.
visual_intent: Angel and Devil Mix ONE ink actor: squat broad asymmetrical splat,ONE little golden half-halo fixed above one head-lobe and ONE small red horn on other side,ONE tiny cream wing and ONE tiny red wing at shoulder lobes,no extra angel/devil. Broad mischievous crooked open grin with TWO upper teeth,unequal eyes
biography: Finds the moral conflict easier when both voices are using his mouth. His HyperNorm halo and horn debate which voice deserves sole ownership. A dissonant card asks whether an ordinary mixed feeling needs a winner. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
note: FrizzleBob: Die innere Einigkeit bleibt mit zwei Stimmen beschlussfähig.

name: Komitee-Eule Abgewogen
personality: Requests another hearing to determine whether anyone has yet been heard.
visual_intent: Ethics Committee Owl metaphor,not animal: tall broad-based ink pear,little cream cap with TWO feather-tuft folds ABOVE eyes,two subtle lashes,small plum collar,ONE thick closed committee book and tiny wooden gavel. Heavy round unequal eyelids,closed dark ink toothless wavy mouth,no owl beak/animal body
biography: Requests another hearing to determine whether anyone has yet been heard. Her HyperNorm book records hearings held to confirm that consultation occurred. A dissonant card asks whether anyone altered the conclusion after listening. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Anhörung wird um die Prüfung des Gehörten erweitert.
